purpose: Pairs canonical engine BOQ lines (URBAN_CANONICAL_BOQ_LINE_V1, by item_code) with the freelancer's COVER_TOTAL rows of tests/alsenan/registers_b1/BENCHMARK_NORMALISED.json, one reference row per key, for tools/alsenan_scoreboard.py. Built by tools/alsenan_keymap.py. Engine item codes are general; only the reference ids are this project's.
rule: an item code answers at most one key; a key has exactly one reference row; a reference total that sums other mapped rows (e.g. total reinforced concrete) is never keyed, so nothing is counted twice; the ARCH.* geometry records of spaces, walls, thresholds and facade are never keyed (they restate measured surfaces, not BOQ items); ARCH.WINDOW is keyed because it is the engine's only window count

keys.note: freelancer subtrade FOOTINGS+STRAPS+PERIMETER; STR.CONC.BOUNDARY_WALL is the strip at FOUNDATION level read as the perimeter footing (to be confirmed by the verifier from the drawing)

keys.reference_unit_source: the row's own label (label_ar 'مساح م2', label_en 'plaster m2'); the normalised record has no unit
the row's own label (label_ar 'صبغ الحوائط م2', label_en 'wall paint m2'); the normalised record has no unit

keys.note: freelancer total floors = dry floors + wet-room floors (its ceramic sheet sums the two); a space held for wet / dry review answers this key as HELD (its floor sits in a CONDITIONAL scenario set, in no line)
freelancer measures aluminium doors in m2, the engine counts leaves in nr: refused as a unit mismatch, never converted
freelancer measures windows in m2, the engine counts windows in nr (ARCH.WINDOW_REVEAL m2 is the reveal, not the window): refused as a unit mismatch

not_keyed.RC:ورقة1:25: rebar tonnage: not in this task's trades
not_keyed.ALU:الغلاف:20: aluminium grand total: sum of rows 16 and 17
